title: Mobile More Menu
summary: Updated mobile navigation with a More page that gathers secondary app destinations in one place.

changes.text: Mobile Navigation: replaced the Settings tab in the bottom dock with a More page linking to Settings, About us, Feedback, and Release Notes.
Responsive Footer: About us, Feedback, and Release Notes links are shown in the footer on desktop and hidden on mobile.
Compact Mobile Navigation: bottom dock tabs display icons without text labels.
